sections.bio:
🚀 Hi, I'm Atul Dhanotiya!

I am a BCA student at Mandsaur University and an aspiring Software Developer passionate about Artificial Intelligence, Web Development, Cloud Technologies, and building real-world solutions.

Currently, I serve as an Internshala Student Partner (ISP) 2026, where I help students discover internships, skill development opportunities, and career growth resources while strengthening my leadership and communication skills.

I believe in learning by building. Over the past year, I have worked on several projects, including:

🔹 BiasGuard AI – An AI-powered platform designed to detect, analyze, and explain bias in AI datasets.
🔹 SmartAttend – A QR-based attendance management system for educational institutions.
🔹 GestureClip – An AI-powered gesture control system that enables cross-device interactions using hand tracking.

Beyond academics, I actively participate in hackathons, coding contests, workshops, and technology communities to continuously improve my technical and leadership skills.

💻 Technical Skills:
• JavaScript
• TypeScript
• HTML & CSS
• Firebase
• Git & GitHub
• Artificial Intelligence
• Web Development

🏆 Highlights:
• Internshala Student Partner (ISP) 2026
• Team Leader – BiasGuard AI
• Participant – Build with AI Solution Challenge
• Google Cloud Learning Programs
• Microsoft Learn Certifications
• Multiple Coding Competitions & Technical Workshops

I am always open to connecting with fellow students, developers, mentors, recruiters, and technology enthusiasts.

📩 Let's connect and build something impactful together!

💰 Stipends up to ₹85K/month
💼 10,000+ internships

There’s also an Early Access Contest for students who want to participate early and unlock additional rewards. 🎁

🎉 Excited to share another milestone in my learning journey!

I'm grateful to have received the 𝗖𝗲𝗿𝘁𝗶𝗳𝗶𝗰𝗮𝘁𝗲 𝗼𝗳 𝗣𝗮𝗿𝘁𝗶𝗰𝗶𝗽𝗮𝘁𝗶𝗼𝗻 for taking part in 𝗖𝗹𝗼𝘂𝗱 𝗤𝘂𝗲𝘀𝘁 2026 – 𝗜𝗻𝗱𝗶𝗮'𝘀 𝗕𝗶𝗴𝗴𝗲𝘀𝘁 𝗖𝗹𝗼𝘂𝗱 𝗤𝘂𝗶𝘇, organized by Cloud Junction. ☁️🚀

This experience was a great opportunity to test my knowledge, explore cloud technologies, and learn alongside thousands of passionate tech enthusiasts from across the country.

Every challenge and every certificate is a reminder that continuous learning is the key to growth. I'm looking forward to exploring more in Cloud Computing, AI, and Modern Development while building impactful projects.

A big thank you to Cloud Junction for organizing such an amazing initiative and encouraging students to keep learning. 💙

Here's to many more milestones ahead! 🚀

#CloudJunction #CloudQuest2026 #CloudComputing #MicrosoftAzure #AWS #GoogleCloud #AI #TechCommunity #StudentDeveloper #Learning #CareerGrowth #Certificate #KeepLearning

🎉 Excited to share that I have successfully completed my Web Development Internship at InAmigos Foundation! 🚀

I'm grateful to have received both a Certificate of Internship and a Certificate of Appreciation for my contributions during the internship.

Over the course of this internship, I had the opportunity to work on practical projects and strengthen my skills in:
💻 Web Development
🤖 AI-assisted Website Development
🎨 UI/UX Design
📊 Website Analysis & Improvement
🌐 Real-world Project Development

This experience not only enhanced my technical knowledge but also improved my problem-solving, creativity, and professional communication.

A heartfelt thank you to the entire InAmigos Foundation (IAF) team for their guidance, support, and encouragement throughout this journey.

Looking forward to applying these learnings to future projects, internships, and new opportunities. The journey of learning continues! 🚀

#Internship #WebDevelopment #InAmigosFoundation #AI #FrontendDevelopment #UIUX #StudentDeveloper #BCA #LearningByDoing #CareerGrowth #OpenToOpportunities
